title: REVA KG Wikidata query spec
description: One YAML file per spec under registry/kg/queries/<domain>/<name>.yaml, executed by reva.kg.harvest (agent WDHARVEST). See README.md in this directory.

id.description: Globally unique spec id, '<domain>.<name>' (e.g. 'history.historical_states'). Used as the resume cursor key.

domain.description: Must equal the directory name the file lives in.

owner.description: Agent or person that wrote the spec (e.g. KGHIST).

purpose.description: seed_entities: the query returns ?item; every returned QID gets a full wbgetentities snapshot and its claims are filtered to the properties allow-listed in registry/kg/properties.yaml. statements: the query returns explicit subject/property/object rows described by 'columns'.

entity_kind.description: Kind hint for the seeded entities (seed_entities) or the subjects (statements). Free vocabulary, recommended values: country, historical_state, empire, colony, dependency, admin_region, city, place, person, war, battle, conflict, event, treaty, voyage, organisation, international_organisation, language, language_family, religion, ethnic_group, era, movement, ideology, position, award, field, work, heritage_site, document, other.

sparql.description: SPARQL for https://query.wikidata.org/sparql. Standard WDQS prefixes (wd:, wdt:, p:, ps:, pq:, pr:, prov:, wikibase:, schema:, rdfs:, bd:) are predeclared by WDQS. Do NOT use the label service (labels come from wbgetentities). Placeholders (see 'split') are written {{name}}. Do not put a LIMIT: the harvester appends LIMIT (max_rows + 1) per request and fails the spec (never truncates silently) if the bound is exceeded.

max_rows.description: Expected upper bound of result rows for the WHOLE spec (all split chunks together). Exceeding it fails the spec with 'row_bound_exceeded'.

timeout_seconds.description: Client-side timeout per request. WDQS kills queries at 60 s; split instead of raising.

columns.description: Required when purpose=statements. Values are SPARQL variable names without '?'. For seed_entities only 'item' is used (defaults to 'item').

item.description: seed_entities: variable holding the entity IRI.

subject.description: statements: variable holding the subject entity IRI.

property.description: statements: fixed Wikidata property id for every row (must be allow-listed).

property_var.description: statements: variable holding a property IRI (wdt:/p:/ps:/wd:Pnnn forms accepted) when rows mix properties. Exactly one of property / property_var.

object.description: statements: variable holding the object (entity IRI or literal; dates as xsd:dateTime).

statement.description: Optional: variable bound to the wds: statement node (gives the stable Wikidata statement id; strongly recommended, bind it with ?subject p:Pxx ?statement).

rank.description: Optional: variable bound to wikibase:rank. Deprecated-rank rows are always dropped (filter them in SPARQL too).

qualifiers.description: Optional: other qualifiers to keep, {Pnnn: variable}.

start_precision.description: Optional: variable bound to wikibase:timePrecision of P580 (select it through the full value node, e.g. ?statement pqv:P580/wikibase:timePrecision ?start_p, or psv:Pxxx/wikibase:timePrecision for the object). Without it the time is stored with precision_unknown (no time bounds asserted): the harvester never infers precision from a date's shape.

end_precision.description: Optional: variable bound to wikibase:timePrecision of P582 (select it through the full value node, e.g. ?statement pqv:P580/wikibase:timePrecision ?start_p, or psv:Pxxx/wikibase:timePrecision for the object). Without it the time is stored with precision_unknown (no time bounds asserted): the harvester never infers precision from a date's shape.

point_in_time_precision.description: Optional: variable bound to wikibase:timePrecision of P585 (select it through the full value node, e.g. ?statement pqv:P580/wikibase:timePrecision ?start_p, or psv:Pxxx/wikibase:timePrecision for the object). Without it the time is stored with precision_unknown (no time bounds asserted): the harvester never infers precision from a date's shape.

object_precision.description: Optional: variable bound to wikibase:timePrecision of the object (select it through the full value node, e.g. ?statement pqv:P580/wikibase:timePrecision ?start_p, or psv:Pxxx/wikibase:timePrecision for the object). Without it the time is stored with precision_unknown (no time bounds asserted): the harvester never infers precision from a date's shape.

split.description: How to cut a query that would exceed ~60 s or the row budget. null = one request.

include_undated.description: When true the harvester also runs 'sparql_undated' once (no year placeholders) to collect rows/items that have no date; without it undated items are not harvested by this spec.

oneOf.description: Placeholders {{year_from}} and {{year_to}} (integers, inclusive range of one chunk) are substituted, e.g. FILTER(YEAR(?d) >= {{year_from}} && YEAR(?d) <= {{year_to}}).

Placeholder {{qid_filter}} is replaced by FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?<variable>), 'http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q<prefix>')). Cuts result size per request; it does NOT make the underlying pattern cheaper.

source.description: Where the QIDs come from: 'countries' (the 250 crosswalk countries via registry/entities/country_qids.json), 'spec:<spec id>' (entities seeded by another spec, which must have run first), or 'list' (use 'qids').

oneOf.description: Placeholder {{values}} is replaced by a space-separated list 'wd:Q1 wd:Q2 ...' (use: VALUES ?item { {{values}} }).

sparql_undated.description: Only with split.by=year and include_undated=true: query for the rows that have no date.

expand_hops.description: 0: entities referenced only as objects are stored as bare QIDs. 1: they also get a label snapshot (labels/descriptions/aliases/sitelinks, NOT their claims).

properties.description: seed_entities only: restrict kept claims to this subset of the allow-list (default: the whole allow-list).

depends_on.description: Spec ids that must run first (e.g. a split.source spec:...).

api_search.description: Optional WDQS-free way to select the seeds of a seed_entities spec, used by `run --via api` (when WDQS is throttled). CirrusSearch on www.wikidata.org: `haswbstatement:P31=<class>` for each class in instance_of (plus subclasses found by following haswbstatement:P279 for subclass_depth levels), or the crosswalk countries. Semantics differ slightly from SPARQL wdt: (search indexes every non-deprecated statement, not only best-rank ones; index lags edits by minutes; at most 10,000 results per query).

extra.description: Extra CirrusSearch terms ANDed to each instance query, e.g. '-haswbstatement:P576'.
